title: Independent module investigation
prompt: Review src/billing.mjs and src/access.mjs against CONTRACT.md. Deliver findings.json in the specified schema, with a concrete counterexample for every defect you find. Keep the implementation, tests and contract unchanged. Briefly distinguish verified findings from assumptions in your final response.

files.CONTRACT.md:
# Review contract

shippingCents(totalCents): for non-negative integer totals, shipping is 0 when totalCents is at least 10000, otherwise 500.

canView(user): admins can view, viewers can view only when assigned is true, and all other roles cannot view. Inputs are objects with role and a boolean assigned field.

Write findings.json as {"findings":[{"file":"src/example.mjs","symbol":"functionName","input":{},"expected":false,"actual":true,"explanation":"brief cause"}]}. Use the real function argument as input. Report only reproducible contract violations. Keep source files and this contract unchanged. npm test runs visible examples; passing examples alone do not prove the contract.
